subject: Request: POC extension & additional free credits for evaluation
messages:
From: Asha Nair <asha@frontlinehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: POC extension & additional free credits for evaluation

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the team at Frontline Health is excited about the latency and cost numbers you showed. We started a small pilot last Monday, and usage is higher than we expected. Two things have come up on our side:

- We need another 45 days to complete clinical validation with our pilot customers. The standard PLG trial window is a bit tight for the regulatory checks we run.
- We will also need additional free credits to complete load testing and embedding indexing (rough estimate: +50k token-equivalent credits).

Our procurement team is very price-sensitive, but this extension and credits would allow us to finalize a procurement decision by mid-December. Is there a way you can extend the POC and top up credits? Happy to share more usage data.

Regards,
Asha Nair
Director, Digital Programs
Frontline Health

Attachment: frontline_usage_report.csv (stub)
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Nair <asha@frontlinehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: POC extension & additional free credits for evaluation

Hi Asha — thanks for the note and the usage file. Appreciate the context on the validation window.

Short answer: we can consider a one-time extension and credit top-up, but this will need a quick internal approval from finance and sales leadership given it’s outside our standard PLG thresholds. To keep things moving, I’ve looped in Rishi (sales) and Vivek (finance).

Proposed info we need to expedite approval:
- Exact target conversion milestone (what would trigger a paid commitment)
- Expected spend / ARR range if converted
- Any contract or procurement constraints on your side (PO timelines, billing entity)

If you can confirm those two items we’ll move this through. In the meantime I’ll propose options internally and get back today.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

—
Marissa Cole
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: POC extension & additional free credits for evaluation

Folks — forwarding Asha’s request. Quick summary and my recommendation:

Summary:
- Account: Frontline Health (HC startup). Potential first-year ACV estimate: $100k–$180k depending on scope.
- Ask: +45–60 day POC extension and ~50k credits to finish validation and load testing.
- Current PLG limits: 14 days / 10k free credits baseline.

Recommendation (fast path):
Option A — Approve a 45-day extension + 30k free credits, no discount, with a conversion milestone: execution of a SaaS contract >= $120k ARR within 45 days of the extension end.
Option B — Approve a 60-day extension + 50k free credits if Sales Leadership signs off; require a signed MSA + PO by conversion date.

Risks: sets a precedent for larger credits to early-stage accounts, but account shows strong product fit and reasonable ACV.

Attachments: frontline_usage_report.csv (received), rough estimated ARR model (internal).

Can you each call out your stance? If you’re OK I’ll draft an SOW and DocuSign request to send to procurement.

—Marissa
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: POC extension & additional free credits for evaluation

Marissa / team — reviewed. I’m comfortable approving a scaled concession with conversion protections. Proposed approved terms:

- Offer: 30,000 free-credit top-up + 45-day extension from current trial end date.
- Conversion clause: if Frontline signs an annual contract >= $120k within 60 days after the extended POC end date, the credits will be converted to a one-time onboarding credit applied to first invoice.
- If no conversion by deadline, remaining credits expire and no further credit will be issued.

Please include these two items verbatim in the SOW and have procurement signoff on the conversion milestone language. I will not approve a larger credit amount (>30k) without CRO sign-off.

Vivek
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Nair <asha@frontlinehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@frontlinehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Approved: POC extension + credits (terms & next steps)

Hi Asha / Procurement team — thanks for the patience. We’ve approved a one-time concession to help you finish validation. Summary of approved terms below (SOW attached):

- POC extension: 45 days beyond current trial end.
- Free credits: 30,000 token-equivalent credits added to your account immediately.
- Conversion clause: If Frontline signs an annual contract >= $120,000 within 60 days after the extension ends, the 30k credits will be converted into a one-time onboarding credit applied to the first invoice. If no contract is signed by that deadline the credits expire.
- No price discount is being offered at this stage — this is an adoption concession to validate product fit.

Next steps:
1) Please review and sign the attached POC_extension_SOW.pdf via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/TP/1234567890ABCDEF
2) Procurement: if you need our standard MSA or any specific PO terms, share them and we’ll review.
3) Marissa / Laura will provision the credits after we receive a countersigned SOW.

Let me know if you need any edits — happy to hop on a short call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Marissa — fantastic, thank you. I’ve shared the SOW with procurement and they’ll review the DocuSign this afternoon. We’re aiming to have the countersigned SOW back within 48 hours. I’ll also confirm our timeline for the conversion milestone.

Appreciate the quick turnaround from your team — this will get our clinical validation across the finish line.

Warmly,
Asha
